key_diagnostic_findings: 1. SITE-WIDE: Mismatch fires on /, /pricing, AND /demo — identical componentStack on all three pages
2. MINIFIED BUILD LIMITATION: The componentStack only shows minified function names (We, St, Rt, k, Le, e) + generic 'Suspense' — no readable component names. This is a production minified bundle.
3. TOP OF STACK IS Suspense: The innermost element is 'Suspense (<anonymous>)' — the mismatch occurs INSIDE a Suspense boundary
4. The Suspense wrapper is rendered by 'We' at offset 868832 inside the minified main.a013f5c4.js bundle
5. The stack sequence: e -> Le -> k -> Rt -> div -> St -> We -> Suspense — this is the App-level component tree, not page content
6. Since /demo has completely different page-level components and still triggers the same mismatch, ALL page-specific suspects (StickyMobileCta, TrustBand, HomeFaq, DemoForm, hero image) are CLEARED

root_cause_analysis.conclusion: The hydration mismatch is in a shared layout/wrapper component rendered by App.js on every route — likely the Router, a persistent layout wrapper, or a lazy-loaded component wrapped in Suspense that is present across all pages.
root_cause_analysis.top_suspect: A Suspense boundary in App.js wrapping a lazily-loaded component that renders differently on server vs client. Since the stack shows 'div > Rt > k > Le > e' above the Suspense, investigate the Router provider chain and any persistent layout components in App.js.
root_cause_analysis.why_minified_names_dont_help: The deployed build is minified. onRecoverableError fires correctly but componentStack only contains mangled names. To get real component names, a SOURCE-MAP-enabled build or running in development mode (yarn start) is needed.

recommendation_for_main_agent: ACTION REQUIRED: The mismatch is SITE-WIDE and in a shared component. All 14 page-specific components previously cleared remain cleared.

NEXT STEP: Inspect App.js for any Suspense boundaries or components that could render differently server vs client. Specifically look for: (a) lazy() imported components wrapped in Suspense, (b) any component using window/document/localStorage without useEffect guard, (c) CmsProvider or HelmetProvider doing SSR-incompatible work.
ALTERNATIVE: Run the diagnostic against a DEV build (yarn start / non-minified) to get real component names in the componentStack — this would immediately identify the exact component.
The onRecoverableError hook is working perfectly — the limitation is the minified bundle obscuring component names.
